description: Configuration for the bare-metal cloud-burst Provisioner backend (ARC-13 / ADR-20, #436): how to burst ephemeral worker nodes on the local host. Mirrors the Azure reference (azure_config.schema.json) / GCP / OCI / Kubernetes via the CLI pattern. Mirrored by zetta::BareMetalConfig in include/zetta/bare_metal_provisioner.hpp and enforced by BareMetalConfig::from_json() in src/core/bare_metal_provisioner.cpp — keep them in sync. No container SDK lives behind the provisioner; this config is interpreted by a BareMetalControlPlane (the reference BareMetalCliControlPlane shells out to the host container runtime — `docker` or `podman` — running each worker as a local container, the cross-OS synchronous-launch mechanism). Bare metal is the local host, not a remote cloud/cluster. A malformed config is rejected at the boundary so a misconfigured burst fails fast instead of bringing up the wrong (or no) fleet.

gpus.description: Give burst workers access to the host's GPUs (the runtime's `--gpus all`). Defaults to false (CPU-only).

image.description: The container image each worker runs (e.g. 'ghcr.io/oramasearch/zetta:latest'). Required — a burst has nothing to run without it.

name_prefix.description: The container name prefix for burst workers (a UUID is appended for uniqueness). Defaults to 'zetta-burst'.

network.description: The container network to attach workers to (e.g. 'host' so a worker can reach the cluster on the host network). Empty uses the runtime's default network.

pool_label.description: The container label applied to every burst worker so list + teardown can find the pool (the stable pool key — like a scale-set name). Defaults to 'zetta-burst'.

runtime.description: The host container runtime CLI to drive — 'docker' or 'podman'. Defaults to 'docker'.

seed_peer.description: The cluster seed address (host:port) injected as the ZETTA_SEED_PEER env var so each worker auto-joins the existing peer cluster at boot. Empty when the join address is supplied another way.

title: BareMetalConfig
